blocking_rules.description: Every published fact must have a source entity, source ID, verifier, verification time and publishable=true.
Numeric facts must include a unit and time window when the value can change over time.
Incomplete, estimated, planned and reconciled quantities must not be described as the same status.
Direct quotations require a source reference, transcript verification and publication consent.
Formal titles, Dharma titles, medical roles and organizational positions require an approved source.
Sensitive or internal facts must not be published.
A person's name or image must not be published without separate consent.
Case, medical, financial and precise-address data require privacy review before approval.
Do not infer emotions, faith, family relationships, diagnosis or helplessness from appearance or circumstance.
The draft must contain a clear event, action and result or next step; activity schedules alone are insufficient.
Do not replace missing facts with abstract value language.

warning_rules.description: Repeated not-only-but-also phrasing is a common generated-text pattern.
Abstract contrast phrasing should be replaced by specific impact.
High value-term density weakens factual credibility.
Emotion and transformation claims require direct evidence.
Use precise circumstances and person-first language instead of labels.
Check that planned outcomes are not presented as completed results.
